(4)
(a)  The  Executive  Committee  of  the  Institute  that
holds office on the day immediately preceding the date of
commencement of this Act, shall function as the  Executive
Committee of the Body Corporate until the first Executive
Committee is elected in the manner provided for by rules
made under section 6.
(b) The first Executive Committee of the Body Corporate
shall be elected within one year of the date of commencement
of this Act.

6.
(1) It shall be lawful for the Body Corporate from
time to time at any general meeting of the Body Corporate
and by the majority of not less than two third of the Corporate
members  and  Affiliate  members  (excluding  Affiliate
Associate  members  and  Affiliate  Probationer  members)
present and voting to make rules not inconsistent with the
provisions  of  this  Act  or  any  other  written  law  for  the
following matters:-

(a)
the grading of the membership and the admission,
withdrawal, expulsion or resignation of members
and fees payable by members;

(b)
 the election of the office bearers, the resignation
from or vacation of or removal from office of office
bearers and their powers, conduct and duties;

(c)
the  election  of  members  of 
the  Executive
Committee and its powers, conduct and duties and
the terms of office of members;

(d)
 the powers, conduct, duties and functions of the
